editors.title: Other video editors at a glance
editors.lead: Jelly Cut is only one of many options. Here are the main programs and what to check before you choose.
editors.hint: Prices, plans and terms change often. Check the official website of the program before you start. The details were checked on the providers' websites in October 2026, without guarantee.
editors.linkNote: The names lead to the official website and open in a new tab.

capcut.cost: Free download. Check plans on the website
capcut.strong: Fast, many templates, automatic subtitles. Easy to start (own assessment)
capcut.watch: Owned by ByteDance. Broad licence on your content. Minimum age 13 for music and templates

premiere.cost: Subscription with a 7-day trial. From 22.99 US dollars a month (annual plan)
premiere.platforms: Windows, macOS. The phone app is free, a separate program
premiere.strong: Industry standard with very many professional features. Hard to learn (own assessment)
premiere.watch: Ongoing costs. Premiere Rush has been discontinued, support ends on 30 September 2026

shotcut.strong: Many formats, colour grading, keyframes. Medium to learn (own assessment)

openshot.cost: Free, according to the website without watermarks or project limits
openshot.strong: Clear interface, effects, keyframes. Easy to start (own assessment)
openshot.watch: Fewer professional tools than Premiere or Shotcut

filmcraft.platforms: Windows, macOS, Linux. Web version to host yourself
filmcraft.strong: Multi-track timeline, about 55 effects, Premiere-like interface. Medium to learn (own assessment)
filmcraft.watch: Open-source clone of Adobe Premiere Pro, largely built by AI agents (no Adobe code). Still young, alpha stage

imovie.account: Not needed. The App Store download needs an Apple ID
imovie.strong: Very simple, works well with Apple devices. Easy to start (own assessment)

clipchamp.cost: Free with a Microsoft account. Premium with Microsoft 365
clipchamp.strong: Simple, HD export without watermarks according to the website. Easy to start (own assessment)
clipchamp.watch: Premium content only with a Microsoft 365 subscription

windowsMovieMaker.strong: Used to be an easy start. Not recommended today
windowsMovieMaker.watch: No support since 2017. Downloads from third-party sites can contain malware. Successor on Windows: Clipchamp

jellycut.strong: Videos stay on your device. No ads

chooser.intro: Answer the questions. Below are the programs that fit all of your answers. This is a guide, not a rule.
chooser.empty: Answer at least one question to see matching programs.
chooser.none: No program fits this combination. Change one answer, for example the account question.

device.label: What do you mainly work on?

files.label: Should your files stay on your device?

account.label: Should it work without an account?

goal.label: What do you want to do with it?

school.label: Does your school prescribe programs or accounts?
school.note: Ask your teacher first which programs and accounts are allowed. Services with a minimum age may need your parents' consent.

editors.merke: A free app sometimes earns money through ads, data or a watermark. Read the licence and the terms before you upload your own videos.
editors.rightsText: What you need to consider for other people's music, images and videos is explained under “Darauf musst du achten” (rights). Free material is listed under “Quellen” (sources).
